title: Read outside your specialty without turning it into a project
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Choose a genuine curiosity — Begin with a subject that matters beyond immediate utility.; Learn its own questions — Notice the distinctions the unfamiliar field considers important.; Keep context attached — Record sources and limits when a connection appears.; Allow an open outcome — Continue, pause, or explore without forcing a deliverable..
